correctness.rationale: Exact expansion and Schmidt block eigenvalues checked. Gram inequality provides diagonal rank-one bounds. For a>=0 largest <=alpha^2, other eigenvalues <=alpha*b, all >=b^2. For a<0 CP yields c/b<=1/d and |psi><psi|<=(d/2)T, giving all eigenvalues <=b^2 and the complementary smallest-eigenvalue constraints. Ky Fan prefix and suffix bounds prove all majorization inequalities for pure inputs; convexity extends to mixtures. Exact rational checks and random examples supplement rather than substitute for proof; no infinite inference from finite tests.

value.rationale: An exact full-Ky-Fan result for two channel uses is the first nontrivial entangled-input case of an explicitly formulated arbitrary-copy conjecture. It covers all dimensions and the non-obvious negative depolarizing-coefficient completely-positive branch. It controls every Schur-concave output spectral quantity simultaneously, whereas previously cited power sums and approximate majorization do not. The n>=3 conjecture and gap refinements remain open.
